messages.subject: overlay points onto world2 map with pacific view
parts:
Dear List-

I am working on biogeography of reef fishes on islands of the south
pacific and am interested in using ggplot to plot my sites on top of a
world map centered on the pacific ocean.
To make a reproducible problem I haven’t included my data, but rather
simulated random lat long sites in that area of the world to show the
problem

#here's the data
z=data.frame(rnorm(50,-4,20),rnorm(50,27,100))
names(z)=c("latitude","longitude")

#heres with teh base maps package


# works fine with initial projection
map('world',fill=T,interior=FALSE,center=180)
map.axes()
points(z$longitude,z$latitude,pch=21,
,cex=2,col=4)

#breaks down uising world2 instead of wolrd
map('world2', xlim = c(100, 300),fill=T,ylim=c(-50,70),interior=F)
map.axes()
points(z$longitude,z$latitude,pch=21,cex=4*(x$ratio),col=4)

#try with ggplot but same problem persists


ggplot()+
geom_path(aes(long,lat,group=group),data=map_data("world"))+
geom_point(aes(longitude,latitude,size=3,pch=16,alpha=1),col="blue",data=z)
+
opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())+
opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank())+
opts(panel.background=theme_rect(fill="white",colour="white"))+
opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(colour="black",size=10))+
opts(axis.text.y=theme_text(colour="black",size=10))+
scale_size(to=c(2,5))

#mow with world2 similar issues
ggplot()+
geom_path(aes(long,lat,group=group),data=map_data("world2"))+
geom_point(aes(longitude,latitude,size=3,pch=16,alpha=1),col="blue",data=z)
+
opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_blank())+
opts(panel.grid.major = theme_blank())+
opts(panel.background=theme_rect(fill="white",colour="white"))+
opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(colour="black",size=10))+
opts(axis.text.y=theme_text(colour="black",size=10))+
scale_size(to=c(2,5))
